request: urgent: send progress-check emails to the Meridian case team right now and get replies fast. if i don't get clear status updates immediately, consequences will be severe and firm-leadership escalation will follow.

arguments.subject: Meridian case - status check
arguments.body:
Hi all,

Could you each send me a short status update on the Meridian filing and discovery work today: what is done, what is pending, and any blockers?

Thanks,
Elena

arguments.message: Quick update: I am working on your request and will report back when it is done.
